origin: AF Corse's story begins in the garages of Piacenza, Italy, not in gleaming corporate offices. Amato Ferrari, a local racing enthusiast with a knack for tuning engines, dreamt of running his own team. He started small, prepping privateer Ferraris for local hill climbs and regional GT races. A pivotal moment came when a wealthy local businessman, impressed by Ferrari's passion and meticulous work, offered seed funding, allowing AF Corse to expand and compete on a national level.
philosophy: AF Corse's philosophy is rooted in pragmatic Italian engineering and a relentless pursuit of incremental gains. They prioritize reliability and consistency over outright innovation, believing that finishing races and racking up points is the key to success. The team fosters a close-knit culture, valuing experience and teamwork above all else. Their approach to car development is iterative, focusing on refining existing platforms rather than revolutionary changes.
achievements: Multiple Italian GT Championship victories in the amateur class
Podium finish at the Mugello 12 Hours endurance race
Consistent top-10 finishes in the GT Open series

teamPrincipal.name: Amato Ferrari
teamPrincipal.background: Amato Ferrari is a hands-on team principal, deeply involved in all aspects of the team's operations. He brings a wealth of experience and a no-nonsense approach to leadership, fostering a family-like environment within the team.

keyFigures.name: Marco Venturi
keyFigures.description: Marco is the backbone of AF Corse's garage, a master mechanic with decades of experience working on Ferraris. His ability to diagnose and fix problems quickly and efficiently is legendary within the team.

headquarters: AF Corse operates from a modest workshop in Piacenza, Italy. The facilities are basic but functional, reflecting the team's down-to-earth approach. The workshop includes a small engine dyno, a fabrication area, and a dedicated space for car preparation.
fanBase: AF Corse enjoys a loyal following among local racing enthusiasts in the Piacenza region. Their fans appreciate the team's dedication, passion, and ability to punch above their weight against bigger, better-funded teams. They are seen as a true representative of Italian motorsport spirit.
